Shot down · Romania

Romanian fighter downs drone reported as Russian over Tulcea coast

25 July 2026 · Tulcea coastal sector

Reported foreign

On 25 July 2026 a drone (UAV) made a brief incursion into Romanian airspace over the Sfântu Gheorghe and Tulcea coastal sector and was destroyed by a Romanian fighter jet. It had made a short entry from the operational area of the war in Ukraine. Fragments were sought afterwards.

The drone was reported as Russian. Its model and payload were under investigation, and its technical identification had not been completed in contemporary accounts.

No casualties were reported.
